reason: I already get my weekly numbers from YouTube Studio and my ideas from ChatGPT, and both are free. Mitra sounds useful, but I can't see what it does that those two don't, and I'm not paying ₹299 a month to find out.
objection: It says it will tell me the 1-3 things to do from my own numbers, but Studio already shows my numbers, and ChatGPT will write me a title and a script for nothing. I don't see what the paid part adds.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on one of my own videos that shows it beat my usual views, so I can see the result before I pay anything.
